analyst_view.overall: Early view: the Klassieker at De Kuip with Feyenoord and Ajax level on 25 points. Feyenoord play Porto at home on 24 November and have gone five games without a win, while Ajax play Thun on 26 November, so they have two days less to recover; Ajax have also struggled in big games this season.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean higher: Feyenoord's keeper Tjark Ernst has been conceding more than expected, Ajax lost control in the second half at Twente after leading 2-0, and Tolu Arokodare's heading is a constant threat.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners, mostly Feyenoord's at home. Both sides cross a lot, but nothing in the news shifts the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. I lean higher: it is the biggest rivalry in the country, both teams are under pressure, and Ajax's Sofyan Amrabat is criticised for diving into too many duels.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.5 shots. Feyenoord at home should have more of the ball, and Ajax's midweek game may make them more cautious; I agree with the total.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. Both attacks have quality, and both keepers have been unconvincing at times; I keep it.
